title: Invertible matrix transformations preserve the cokernel
statement: Let R be a commutative ring, m a natural number, and D, P, Q square matrices indexed by Fin m over R. If P and Q are units for matrix multiplication, then (Fin m → R)/image(D) is R-linearly isomorphic to (Fin m → R)/image(P D Q), where each image is the image of multiplication on column vectors.
lean_statement: ∀ (R : Type*) [CommRing R] (m : ℕ) (D P Q : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) R), IsUnit P → IsUnit Q → Nonempty (((Fin m → R) ⧸ LinearMap.range (Matrix.mulVecLin D)) ≃ₗ[R] ((Fin m → R) ⧸ LinearMap.range (Matrix.mulVecLin (P * D * Q))))
